author: Juan Miguel Rivera
content: Check your base case first. The recursion should stop when the subarray has 0 or 1 elements. If the range never shrinks, the recursion never ends.

author: Patricia Lim
content: Also watch how you compute the middle index. Use left + (right - left) / 2 and make sure both halves are strictly smaller than the original.

author: Justin Adrian Cayabyab
content: Injective means no two inputs share an output. Bijective means injective and every output is used, so the two sets pair up perfectly.
